name: Software Engineering
summary: The Sønderborg version of software engineering, with more weight on distributed systems, embedded devices, software architecture and cyber security — software that runs inside machines as much as on screens. Teaching is in international project groups. No prior programming experience is expected.

family.name: Software Engineering
family.differs: More embedded devices, distributed systems and security, in an international study environment; the larger intake.
